short: Operational Intelligence is the reasoning layer between enterprise telemetry and human decision.
support: Telemetry here means live operations data: logs, metrics, traces, and related signals. Operational Intelligence connects those signals, customer journeys, system maps, operational memory, evaluations, and human review so teams can understand what changed, why it matters, what evidence supports it, and what should happen next.
questions: What should a human review next?
What should the system learn for next time?
